title: William Barr interviews Epstein's cellmate, who later dies

tellings.quote:
Donald Bar's son is a guy named William
Bar, the attorney general under Trump,
who personally visited Epstein's jail
cell after he died to interview his last
known cellmate, Ephra Stone Reyes, who
apparently expressed skepticism around
Epstein's suicide.

plain: After the financier Jeffrey Epstein died in his New York jail cell in 2019, William Barr, then attorney general (the top law officer) under President Trump, is said to have gone to the cell in person to interview Epstein's last known cellmate, a man named Efrain Reyes. According to Michels, Reyes expressed doubt that Epstein's death was a suicide. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, while pointing out that Barr is the son of a man named Donald Barr, and he raises it as a reason to question the official account of the death.
